facts.business: INOX India Ltd is a global leader in integrated cryogenic solutions, providing high-performance equipment and systems for LNG, industrial gases, hydrogen, and cryo-scientific applications across the cryogenic value chain.

segments.name: Cryogenic Equipment (LNG, Industrial Gases, Hydrogen, Cryo-Scientific)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Accelerating execution on the strong LNG order backlog while deepening capabilities in mini-LNG terminal technology for global deployment.

Investing in the engineering and manufacturing capabilities required to address the nascent but rapidly formalising liquid hydrogen demand wave from India's National Green Hydrogen Mission and global hydrogen economy initiatives.
Growing the CSD division's contribution to national space and defence infrastructure, and expanding its international footprint.

auditor.name: M/s. S R B C & Co LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: There are no reservations, qualifications, or adverse remarks in the Independent Auditor's Report.

key_risks: Order Book Execution: Orders subject to revision, delay, or cancellation.
Cybersecurity & Technology: Increasing digitalisation raises exposure to system failures and cyber threats.
Geopolitical & Export Risk: 59% export revenues expose the Company to trade policy shifts and shipping disruptions.
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for related party transactions with INOX Air Products Private Limited (IAPL) for an aggregate value of up to Rs 200 Crores during FY 2026-27, to be carried out at arm's length and in the ordinary course of business.
